title: Aesthetic translucent paper bag vase
author: svet.DIY
description:
Aesthetic translucent vase inspired by a soft paper bag shape ✨

This design creates a unique illusion of a crumpled package while staying minimal and modern. Perfect for dried flowers, small plants or as a stylish decor piece 🤍

The translucent filament beautifully diffuses light and adds a soft aesthetic vibe to any interior

✨ Easy to print

✨ Perfect for vase mode

✨ Best with PLA / PETG
